9852:The tokkl-api36 emulator keeps the system font scale at 2.0 across boots. Every instrumented class that does not set its own scale runs at 200%, so a screen test meant for the default size checks the largest size instead. Screenshots taken at the default scale also come out at 200%. SystemFontScale puts back whatever value it read before the test, so once one run leaves 2.0 behind, later runs keep restoring it. The script resets other settings on an emulator it boots, but not the font scale.
